notes: SwarmPepes in src/SwarmPepes.sol takes no constructor arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals once to msg.sender. Transfers are fee-free; the token has no public mint, burn, administrative, or upgrade functions. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool fee is 0.3% with tick spacing 60. initialPrice is a provenance-only reference: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), treating SwarmPepes as currency0 and the specified pair token as currency1. The deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply using the deployed currencies' address order.
